title: 보건의료인력 수급추계위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Methods and Frequency of Supply and Demand Estimates)
(1) Matters necessary for methods, including models, assumptions, and variables, for medium- and long-term estimates of supply of and demand for healthcare personnel under Article 23-2 (1) of the Framework Act on Health and Medical Services (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as "supply and demand estimates") shall be determined through deliberation and resolution of the Supply and Demand Estimation Committee under that paragraph (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee"), taking into account changes in the healthcare environment, including demographic structure and technological development.
(2) Supply and demand estimates shall be conducted every five years for each occupation under the subparagraphs of Article 23-2 (1) of the Act; provided, where the Minister of Health and Welfare deems it necessary for formulating policies for the training of healthcare personnel under Article 25 of the Act, such estimates may be conducted at shorter intervals.
